concepts_addressed: Platform Choice and Backup Channel Resilience

claims.text: Greg Short (Bloom, 2025 TikTok Shop Summit) asserts that TikTok Shop actively embraces sellers and affiliates to a degree not matched by other retailers, digital channels, or social media platforms, making it the most seller-friendly commerce channel he has observed.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
conditions: Observation from attending TikTok Shop Summit as a seller
bounded_by: Claim is a personal observation from one event attendance; no quantitative data provided

claims.text: Greg Short (Bloom, 2025 TikTok Shop Summit) observes that overseas business culture integrates relationship-building directly into commerce — through dinners, family invitations to business meetings, and out-of-office collaboration — in contrast to American commerce norms, which he views as relationship-poor by comparison.
claims.speaker: Greg Short
claims.topic: Platform Choice and Backup Channel Resilience
conditions: Based on Greg Short's personal cross-cultural business experience
bounded_by: Speaker does not name specific countries; characterization of overseas culture is broad and unverified

practices.text: Adopt relationship-first commerce norms (shared meals, family-inclusive business events, out-of-office collaboration) in American business contexts, as modeled by TikTok's approach to seller relations.
